title: gpt-image-2
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Primary request: Film storyboard sequence in 4 panels. Panel 1: an astronaut repairs a spacecraft in orbit, medium shot, calm. Panel 2: a meteor shower appears in the distance, wide shot, tension rising. Panel 3: the astronaut dodges debris, dynamic close-up, motion blur. Panel 4: the astronaut reaches the airlock, over-the-shoulder shot, warm interior light. Consistent astronaut suit and spacecraft design across all panels, cinematic lighting
Style/medium: film storyboard, cinematic illustration, sequential narrative
Composition/framing: 4 horizontal panels showing progression
Lighting/mood: cinematic, shifting from cold exterior to warm interior
Color palette: deep space black, cold blue, warm amber interior highlights
Constraints: consistent character and spacecraft, no text, no speech bubbles
